title: tk's note-line timestamp is LOCAL time; the Workers host is UTC-only — record the divergence as a decision
body: tk stamps note lines with time.Now() in the process's local zone (note.go), while the TypeScript client renders UTC — identical on the Workers host (always UTC) and on the corpus generator (TZ pinned to UTC), but a divergence for any tk writing from a non-UTC checkout in the same repository the run publishes to. It cannot be fixed on the Workers side; it is a cross-host property worth pinning as a recorded decision so nobody re-derives it from a confusing diff.
